ask: Do the two ways of saying a word stay apart as you want? Please also send partner clips.
problem: Amina ties the key word Logos to her take by hand. The app cannot tell if she said it. Logos may be said two ways in Dinka, by context.
found: My first version stored clips per word only, so two ways of saying it would mix. You were right. I fixed it before it ships.
changed: Each written way of saying a word now has its own clips. Repeats stay together; other ways stay apart. Clips with no written way go under Another way. Pictures show the routes and flow.
why: Hint means the phone only suggests; it never blocks and saves nothing. A take with any way counts as heard. Pictures are drawings in app colours, not screenshots; no live app runs here.
touches: A new database migration. 15 translations I wrote need a native reader. Phones download the new clips. Play store answers stay the same.
